business_overview.one_sentence: Fenbi provides PRC non-formal vocational education and training, mainly tutoring services, plus books and other sales.

segments.business_substance: Offline classroom-based and online tutoring courses, membership packages and challenge exercises.
segments.source: Annual Report 2025, Segment information, PDF pages 152-153

segments.business_substance: Textbooks, learning materials, related printing business and health goods.
segments.source: Annual Report 2025, Segment information, PDF pages 152-153

business_overview.revenue_model: Tutoring revenue is recognized over time; book and other goods revenue is recognized when goods are delivered. Course fees are typically paid in advance before courses begin.
business_notes: 2025 revenue declined 4.1% due to low-price competition in recruitment examination tutoring.
Substantially all external customer revenue is generated in the PRC.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: 2025 operating cash flow exceeded net profit, but working capital was a cash drag and venue leases consume cash outside operating cash flow. The sustainable distributable cash base excludes treasury income/fair value gains and allows for lease principal payments and competition pressure.
